relations.source_dependency_scope: All newly emitted code/configuration/text dependencies used by a programme must be in the declared roster; all inherited dependencies must be exact earlier allowed view/tool/artifact plan members. relations.source_roster: The manifest lists every newly produced programme source file exactly once in ascending unsigned UTF8 bytes of relative_path, never a locale or JSON object key order. relations.static_source_identity: ABI.source_capture, assembler_source and every dispatcher_source are exact ordinary code members of the same full admitted source closure. relations.two_arm_barrier: Both arm source rosters/manifests/receipts must completely validate and finish before the first ProgrammeSeal publication. Registration of one common ProgrammeCaptureHandle precedes any validation/clock/IO and each arm/file/publication slot precedes its effect. Both raw-success arms then publish seals in fixed Condition order. If the second seal fails, the first completed seal is retained evidence but the handle remains failed and no consumer receives pair promotion. No recapture/retry/new budget after any failed/unknown effect.
relations.whole_workspace_partition: A bounded complete metadata inventory of the already-owned arm workspace must partition exactly into: the fixed manifest; declared new source files and their exact ancestor directories; source-owned private lifecycle/control outputs already classified by the original fixed caller; and exact preexisting immutable tool/view/artifact members from the earlier captured preparation inventories/allowed plan domains. Each path has one class; collisions/overwrites/foreign/unlisted paths, symlinks/devices/FIFOs/sockets in the programme-source class refuse. No new body read of inherited model/data/header/key/assets follows from a descriptor. If the original plan does not supply a complete typed permitted-domain/inventory join, capture refuses rather than classifying unknown files as assets.

source_owner_boundaries: Metadata types do not create actual ParentCustody, PairHandle, DevelopmentAttemptHandle, BackendAttemptHandle, HBackendAdmissionHandle or completion handle.
